title: Client Permission Agent I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 119. Manually triggered only (envelope.metadata, the same mechanism proof_circuit and Fn 125 already use) -- see dispatch.py's own module-section docstring for why: prompt.md's own triggers (Fn 26 Client Advocacy Harvester, Fn 47 Case Study Writer) both exist in this repo but neither ever reaches a state that would call this function today. Fn 26 reliably returns naming_decision=blocked-no-consent (no consent-record fixture is wired). Fn 47's own payload builder unconditionally declines every draft (docs/permission-register.yaml is default-deny and nothing in it is CLEARED). This function checks the register (read-only, via functions/02-brand-steward-qa/permission_check.py) before ever calling a model, and never writes to it.

context.description: What milestone or moment makes this an ask -- supplied by whoever triggers this function, never invented here.

clearance_status.description: The register's own status string for client_name -- always non-CLEARED when a model call is made at all.

voice_profile.description: Fn 114's latest executive_voice_profile signal payload, or null if none has been published yet.

passes_combination_test.description: Industry + shape + numbers, no proper noun, no identifying combination -- reported so the fact checker can see it, never used here to silently skip the card.
